title: Make closing-witness negative tests discriminate each guard and remove the restore tautology
outcome: Witness tests exercise actual resource-reset, generation, terminal, store, stale-job and unbound guards; restore helper does not present manual binding installation as restoration proof.
acceptance: Behavioral negative cases distinguish session_resource_reset_in_progress, successor generation mismatch, terminal failure, authority-store change, stale off-thread job and witness unbound guard without an earlier unrelated predicate masking each case.

Remove the assert_restore_uses_existing_binding_rule subassertion that installs A then asserts A, retaining meaningful persisted root, focus and lookup checks and explicit baseline restore limitation.
